notes.title: Fixed all the known issues!
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where the axis input didn't work on some environments.
- Fixed an issue where the 22nd level of Chapter-1 couldn't be cleared.
- Now support joystick input.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32002992/19e0aa61bf34f8d4b07694f40fbad29f9d21c9bb.png
Unfortunately, there were a few issues that affect play.

I apologize for any inconvenience to playing Box Cat

We want to thank everyone that shared game play experiences.

Please remember that we read, check and answer every single review.

We will continue to work hard to ensure the game is as enjoyable as possible.


Thank you
